data.title: Should Ethereum Tax Its Apps to Prove Its Security Is Worth It?
data.description: Jeff Dorman, Chief Investment Officer and co-founder of Arca, says Vitalik Buterin’s push to treat ETH as a store of value is misguided and argues Ethereum must build its own stablecoin and DEX or tax its apps.
